coverage.scope: Official Ist-Daten v2 public datastore rail exports (PRODUKT_ID=Zug), paired REAL departure/arrival events at Swiss numeric station IDs. Complete filtered exports verified; nationwide service coverage and equivalence to original uploaded CSV archives are not independently established.

funnel.step: Both stops have Swiss 7/9-digit numeric IDs
Neither record is cancelled or pass-through
No contradictory REAL arrival/departure order within either call
Departure A and arrival B statuses are both REAL
Required scheduled and REAL timestamps are present
Positive scheduled segment and chronological realized events
Absolute delay at most 12 hours: declared date-integrity guard

models.interpretation: Retrospective conditional prediction from final REAL records; publication-time availability is not established. Approved by the project author on 2026-10-19.

config.prediction_interpretation: Retrospective conditional prediction from final REAL records; publication-time availability is not established. Approved by the project author on 2026-10-19.

ridge.limitation: Within-journey dependence retained; shared day/route shocks not fully represented. Only three held-out days.

hist_gradient_boosting.limitation: Within-journey dependence retained; shared day/route shocks not fully represented. Only three held-out days.

models.test_evaluation_policy: Original model configurations fixed before held-out evaluation; selected using validation MAE. No tuning on test. Subsequent diagnostic baseline and subgroup analyses are explicitly exploratory.
models.additional_diagnostic: Bias-corrected persistence was added after initial test inspection to distinguish model gains from a constant departure-to-arrival offset. The offset is fitted on training rows only; no test tuning. It did not select or change the original models.
